ana: quick draft idea  add a tiny 'eviction + canary rollforward' cheat-sheet under Dedicated Provisioning. include a short decision tree, a python SDK snippet for reassigning tenants, and a one-line CLI for marking pools as drain. cc @leo @morgan

leo: SGTM. decision tree should prefer rollforward to alt pool in same region, then revert traffic to previous model if no pools available. call out eviction_grace_period and eviction_priority_label.

morgan: add concrete thresholds/examples: canary window 5m, p95 < 250ms, error_rate < 0.5%. show commands: `redwood-cli pool set-state --pool <pool> --state drain` and `redwood-cli provision rollforward --id <id> --pool <pool>`.

ana: small python snippet for doc (very short):

```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
# reassign tenant back to previous pool
client.provisionings.update("tenant_123", reserved_pool="eu-west-1-reserved-a")
```

sre-bot: reminder: link check flagged /ops/infra/terragrunt/provisioning -> ops/infra/terragrunt/provisioning/README.md in prior PRs. please update links in the section.

leo: i'll add a one-liner about isolation_label preventing some reassigns and link to eng-sre runbook on preemption thresholds. ana, want to keep the cheat-sheet to ~6 bullets so it's scannable.

ana: will push a tiny PR with the decision tree, the python snippet, the CLI lines, and the link fixes. keeping it minimal. thanks :thumbsup:
